Mark your calendar, Pasco — Kimora is taking over the Main Floor with an intermediate-advanced Heels Dance Class you do NOT want to sleep on. 🔥👠 Thursday, September 24 at 7PM, the choreo drops and the floor gets hot. $10 gets you in, cocktail optional but highly recommended. Heels not required — just bring the energy and the drive to level up. Spots fill fast when Kimora's teaching, so don't be the one hearing about it Thursday morning. This is your heads-up: clear your Thursday, we'll see you on the floor. 💃✨

Heels clicking, mirrors catching every angle, bass thumping low under Kimora's count — this is what Thursday nights are made for. 🖤✨ Cocktail in one hand, confidence stacking with every step of the choreo. This is the Main Floor at its most electric: full attitude, full sound, full body sweat session dressed up as a night out. Feel the floor, feel the heat, feel yourself. 💋🔥

Whether you've been serving looks in heels for years or you're just curious to try, this room is built for growth, not judgment. Stretch, sweat, serve — together. Bring your dance crew or come solo and find one, either way you're leaving with more swagger than you walked in with. Community that moves, literally.
